overview: The Medford City Council approved a zoning overlay district for Medford Square and passed a resolution requesting that the Mayor fund the legal defense of the Council in federal litigation regarding the city's Values-Aligned Local Investments Ordinance.

items.title: Medford Square City Hall Overlay District Zoning Amendment
items.summary: Approved the Medford Square City Hall Overlay District zoning amendment following recommendations from the Community Development Board. The Council discussed the building timeline for the city hall parking lots and concerns regarding parking accessibility for senior center visitors.

items.title: Resolution for Legal Defense Funding in Chertok v. City of Medford
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting the Mayor appropriate $75,000 for the legal defense of the City Council in a federal lawsuit challenging the Values-Aligned Local Investments Ordinance. Supporters advocated for protecting the democratic process and the ordinance's ethical goals, while opponents cited the city's fiscal challenges and the potential for high legal fees in a likely loss.
